items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Horace Henderson was on piano.

ctx.x: Yeah.-- and Sidney DeParis. Now, Shirley Clay, he got him from Earl Hines. And the trombones was Claude Jones and Bennie Morton and myself. And the saxophones was Rupert Cole and Edward Inge and Bob Carroll and, of course, Don himself. And Horace Henderson was on piano.
